title: Transposable elements contribute to activation of maize genes in response to abiotic stress
genotypes: B73; Mo17; Oh43 (cold tolerance not stated)
growth_system: soil (1:1 autoclaved field soil:MetroMix), natural light, July 2013; chamber vs greenhouse, photoperiod and location NR (UV applied under growth-chamber conditions; light same for all stress and control conditions)
other_factors: genotype; other stresses vs same control: heat 50 °C 4 h; high salt 300 mM NaCl 20 h before sampling; UV-B 2 h
timepoints_duration: single time point: sampled immediately after 16 h cold, collection at 9 am; 24 h recovery used only for growth/lesion phenotyping (not RNA-seq)
bio_reps: 3 for control, cold and heat in B73 and Mo17 (replicates grown 3 days apart); 1 for salt and UV in B73 and Mo17 and for all conditions in Oh43
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 2000, TruSeq libraries, 10-20 M reads per sample; read layout NR
other_omics: none (growth phenotype after recovery; qPCR validation; Trinity de novo assemblies; TE annotation analysis)
key_finding: TE families inserted near gene TSSs associate with cold-, heat-, salt- and UV-induced gene up-regulation across three inbreds.
source_of_details: PMC full text; PMC page Data Availability statement; web search
notes: Added by hand (BioProject not linked to the paper in NCBI). The article's own Data Availability statement says RNA-seq data are in NCBI SRA under study PRJNA244661 (seen on the PMC page). Erratum (PMC4599801) says the SRA accession numbers in the original S1 Table were incorrect and replaces S1 Table (XLSX with sequencing depth per sample; not read), so run-level accessions must come from the BioProject. Multi-stress panel (cold/heat/salt/UV vs shared control); only cold and heat replicated, and only in B73 and Mo17 (salt, UV and all Oh43 libraries unreplicated); n_libraries 27 = B73 and Mo17 (3 control + 3 cold + 3 heat each = 18) + salt and UV 1 each in B73 and Mo17 (4) + Oh43 control, cold, heat, salt, UV (5), assuming the single salt/UV libraries share the replicated control. Methods give both six seedlings pooled per sample and eight plants pooled per replicate. Reads mapped to AGPv2 (TopHat), DESeq for replicated samples.
